title: Rapid Combustion
description: Not all burning is the same. Learn the fastest kind of combustion to reclaim ember 6.

content.value: Combustion can happen at different speeds and in different ways. The three main types are RAPID combustion, SPONTANEOUS combustion, and EXPLOSION. This lesson focuses on the most familiar one: rapid combustion.
In RAPID COMBUSTION, a substance burns quickly and produces heat and light in a short time. It needs an outside source of heat to start, like a spark or flame. Once lit, it keeps burning steadily.

RAPID COMBUSTION
🔥  a gas stove lighting when you bring a flame
🕯️  a candle burning steadily
🪵  wood burning in a bonfire
→ fast, gives heat + light, needs a spark/flame to start

When you light a gas burner with a lighter, the LPG undergoes rapid combustion — it bursts into flame instantly and keeps burning while gas flows. A candle, a matchstick and a campfire are all rapid combustion too. It's the everyday burning we see most often.
Rapid combustion always needs an initial heat source to reach the fuel's ignition temperature — that's why you need a spark or flame to start a gas stove.
Key Takeaway: In rapid combustion, a fuel burns quickly, giving out heat and light in a short time, once started by an external spark or flame — like a gas stove, candle or campfire.
